# VERSA Integrated Solutions

> > VERSA Integrated Solutions is an IT engineering firm specializing in unified communications, cybersecurity, and infrastructure solutions for federal government clients.

Based in Calverton, Maryland, VERSA provides enterprise IT services to agencies including NOAA, Department of Commerce, and NTIS. The company holds ISO certifications and maintains strategic partnerships with Cisco, Microsoft, Citrix, and Dell, with expertise in VoIP, network security, cloud solutions, and custom emergency response tools.

## Key Topics

- Unified Communications
- Government Contracting
- Cisco Emergency Responder (CER)
- vERL-2S (VERSA ERL to Switchport Tool)
- E911 and Emergency Response Locations
- VoIP and Network Security
- Department of Commerce
- NOAA
- ISO Certifications
- Cloud Solutions
- Cybersecurity
- Custom Automation Tools
- IT Infrastructure
- Software Development
